about: Field truth, Virginia Beach, Tue 17 Nov 2026, 7:06 AM (Batch FIX, Section 1). Two loads of the app a minute apart said two different winds now, leaning to two different stations. Times local (America/New_York) unless marked Z.

place.name: VB oceanfront / 1st St Jetty
place.note: The 13 Nov point (fixtures/truth/2026-11-13-vb.json), the same jetty.

feeds.note: The two stations' readings as the field notes give them (docs/batches/batch-fix.md, Section 1): speed, direction, observed time. The raw bodies were not saved; these are those readings in each feed's own shape. Neither note gives a gust, so none is here.

model.note: The forecast the phone had at 7:06 was not saved. A flat stand-in for the replay only, so the station's lean can be seen: 3.0 m/s (5.8 kt) from 30 degrees, gusts 4.5 m/s, every hour of the day. No number from it is a claim about the morning.

diagnosis: The second load leaned to KNTU at 70 minutes. With both feeds answered the old pick chose Cape Henry whether the beach's facing came back or not; it chose KNTU only when Cape Henry's feed gave nothing on that load. Replayed in tests/windStation1117.test.ts.
